concerns.text: "Data merge success rate is measured against the total number of unique AGP participant IDs" lacks a concrete pass/fail threshold (e.g., ≥ 80% overlap) making the criterion unmeasurable for acceptance.

"Model predictive performance (R²) is measured against a high percentile of the permutation-based null distribution (1000 iterations)" does not specify which percentile (90th, 95th, etc.), so the success condition cannot be objectively evaluated.

"sensitivity analysis sweeping the rarefaction depth threshold over the set {5,000,, min_depth}" contains a syntax error (double comma) and does not clearly define the upper bound or step size, preventing reproducible testing of the sweep.
